sourceBaseline.source: operator-verified Greenfield v1.7.6 release package (user upload)

change.purpose: Make AI-requested runtime control a validated, bounded Greenfield-owned control point: enforce EIC terminal controls (retire the logical GFW and all duplicate slots), add whitelisted SET_QUANTUM/SET_PRIORITY, publish the contract in every FULL prompt, and send COMPACT follow-up prompts inside the same conversation.
change.rootCause: resolveGreenfieldControl classified STOP_PROCESS/status=DONE as state DONE without controllerOverride, so a local Hjalmar CONTINUE verdict survived and the DONE commit + logical-GFW queue retirement never ran.
change.precedence: operator runtime control > validated Greenfield owner state > AI runtime-control request

operations.COMPLETE_MISSION: requires status=DONE or STOP_PROCESS; retires all slots of the logical savedMissionId
operations.SET_QUANTUM: integer 1..15, target slot only, effective from next quantum/activation
operations.SET_PRIORITY: LOW|NORMAL|HIGH|URGENT, not above operator ceiling, immediate non-preemptive

change.legacyNormalization: status=DONE / sessionAction=STOP_PROCESS -> COMPLETE_MISSION for the prompt's own target
change.promptProfile: FULL at every session boundary (start/restore/rotation/queue activation/reload/conversation change) and ordinals 1,11,21,...; COMPACT otherwise with dispatch-time FULL upgrade
alsoFixed: MISSION_RESTORE admitted as A2A message type
side panel sends only edited queue field
